active_reply_percent.description: Chance to join each ordinary QQ group message, from 0 to 30 percent.

natural_chat_style.description: Keep QQ replies concise and conversational instead of assistant-like.

enforce_short_casual_replies.description: Deterministically keep casual QQ replies to one short sentence.

casual_reply_max_chars.description: Maximum characters retained for a casual reply, from 16 to 120.

forget_expired_negative_context.description: Drop older hostile or negative exchanges from model context while preserving the current exchange.

recent_negative_context_messages.description: Recent context messages allowed to retain short-term negative context, from 0 to 20.

hidden_affinity_enabled.description: Use private per-user affinity to adjust relationship warmth without exposing scores.

affinity_manager_ids.description: Bot administrator sender IDs allowed to query private affinity state.

hidden_romance_enabled.description: Allow restrained romance after sustained affinity and repeated explicit romantic interest.

affinity_min_award_minutes.description: Minimum minutes between affinity awards for one user, from 0 to 1440.

affinity_daily_gain_cap.description: Maximum affinity gained by one user per UTC day, from 0 to 20.

affinity_inactivity_grace_days.description: Inactive days before affinity begins a slow decay toward neutral.
